domain_restrictions: a equals floor of n times t, so a is an integer
a divided by n lies in the real interval [0, 1)
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all integers n with n > 1 and for all real t with 0 <= t < 1, define a to be floor of n times t; then E_n(t) is less than or equal to E_n(a divided by n).
quantifier_order: let a be floor(n*t) (deterministic definition, not an extra quantifier)

variables.name: n
variables.role: main index for the function E_n

witness_dependencies: a depends deterministically on n and t via a = floor(n*t)

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with 0 <= t < 1, if a = floor(n*t), then E_n(t) <= E_n(a/n).
